mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, name, enabled, created_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT r.role_name FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.name FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_name = 'GENERAL_EMPLOYEE' AND u.enabled = TRUE
AND u.user_id IN
#{userId}
ORDER BY u.user_id
